title: Grandpa Pig's Boat
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig, this is my little brother George,
lines.zh: 我是佩奇，这是我的弟弟乔治，

lines.en: this is Mummy Pig, and this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa Pig.
Grandpa Pig's Boat.
Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George out for a day on the river.
lines.zh: 猪奶奶和猪爷爷要带佩奇和乔治去河里玩一天。

lines.en: Welcome aboard, me hearties!
Peppa, George, let's put your life jackets on.
lines.zh: 佩奇，乔治，我们穿上救生衣吧。

lines.en: When Peppa and George are on Grandpa Pig's boat, they must wear life jackets.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治在猪爷爷的船上时，必须穿救生衣。

lines.en: On this boat, I'm the captain.
Aye, aye, captain.
Aye, aye, captain.
When Captain and Grandpa tells you all to do something, you must do it.
lines.zh: 当队长和爷爷告诉你们要做某事时，你们就必须去做。

lines.en: Unless it's something silly.
lines.zh: 除非是一些愚蠢的事情。

lines.en: Captain and Grandpa never says anything silly.
lines.zh: 队长和爷爷从来不说傻话。

lines.en: Of course not, Captain and Grandpa.
George, raise the flag.
Peppa, ring the bell.
Aye, aye, captain.
Granny Pig, take the wheel.
Aye, aye, captain.
Full sail.
Full sail.
Maybe you should go a little slower, Grandpa Pig.
lines.zh: 也许你应该走慢一点，猪爷爷。

lines.en: Good idea, Granny Pig. I don't want to use up all my petrol.
lines.zh: 好主意，猪奶奶。我不想用完我所有的汽油。

lines.en: Grandpa, I liked it when we went fast.
lines.zh: 爷爷，我喜欢我们走得快。

lines.en: Don't worry, Peppa. We'll go fast later.
lines.zh: 别担心，佩奇。稍后我们就走快点。

lines.en: Look, there's another boat.
Here's Granddad Dog. He's taking Danny Dog out for a day on the river.
lines.zh: 这是狗爷爷。他要带小狗丹尼去河里玩一天。

lines.en: Ahoy there, Granddad Dog.
Ahoy there, Grandpa Pig.
Hello, Danny.
Hello, Peppa.
Granddad Dog is Grandpa Pig's very best friend.
lines.zh: 狗爷爷是猪爷爷最好的朋友。

lines.en: Ho ho ho ho ho.
I'm surprised your boat is still afloat, Granddad Dog.
lines.zh: 我很惊讶你的船还在漂浮，狗爷爷。

lines.en: It must be almost as old as you are.
This old boat can go faster than your rusty bucket, eh, day, Grandpa Pig?
lines.zh: 这艘老船比你生锈的水桶跑得还快，诶，猪爷爷？

lines.en: All right, you old sea dog. Race you.
lines.zh: 好吧，你这个老水手。与你赛跑。

lines.en: Prepare to lose, water hog.
Ruff, ruff, ruff.
You two are acting like little children.
lines.zh: 你们两个表现得像小孩子一样。

lines.en: Granddad Dog called me a water hog.
You called him a sea dog first, Grandpa.
You should say sorry.
Only if he says sorry first.
Granddad, say sorry to Grandpa Pig.
lines.zh: 爷爷，向猪爷爷说对不起。

lines.en: He is your best friend.
No, he's a water hog and my boat is faster than his.
lines.zh: 不，他是个水霸，我的船比他的快。

lines.en: All right, sea dog. Let's race to the next bridge.
lines.zh: 好吧，海狗。让我们跑到下一座桥吧。

lines.en: On the count of three... One, two... Go!
You started too soon.
Catch me if you can, water hog.
lines.zh: 如果可以的话，来抓我吧，水霸。

lines.en: Ruff, ruff.
Sea dog.
Is that as fast as you can go?
lines.zh: 这是你能跑的最快速度吗？

lines.en: Can't catch me.
I win.
Oh, dear. Grandpa Pig's boat has run out of petrol.
lines.zh: 哦，亲爱的。猪爷爷的船没油了。

lines.en: Very clever, Captain Grandpa.
Maybe I did go a bit too fast.
lines.zh: 也许我确实走得太快了一点。

lines.en: How will we get home?
Look, there's Granddad Dog.
Granddad Dog can tow us home.
lines.zh: 狗爷爷可以拖我们回家。

lines.en: I'm not being towed by that sea dog.
lines.zh: 我不会被那只水手拖走。

lines.en: I haven't offered to tow the water hog.
lines.zh: 我还没有主动提出拖水车。

lines.en: Will you two ever grow up?
Grandpa, say sorry to Granddad Dog.
lines.zh: 爷爷，向狗爷爷说声对不起。

lines.en: I'm sorry I called you a sea dog.
Granddad, say sorry to Grandpa Pig.
lines.zh: 爷爷，向猪爷爷说对不起。

lines.en: I'm sorry I called you a water hog.
That's nice.
Granddad Dog, would you be so kind as to tow us home?
lines.zh: 狗爷爷，您能好心拖我们回家吗？

lines.en: It would be my pleasure, madam.
Catch this, Captain.
Aye, aye, skipper.
Granddad Dog is Grandpa Pig's very best friend.
lines.zh: 狗爷爷是猪爷爷最好的朋友。

lines.en: Ruff, ruff.
Granddad Dog is towing Grandpa Pig's boat home.
lines.zh: 狗爷爷拖着猪爷爷的船回家。

lines.en: The main thing is, I won the race.
lines.zh: 最主要的是，我赢得了比赛。

lines.en: Grandpa Pig.
Naughty Grandpa Pig.
Ho, ho, ho. Peppa, ring the bell.
Aye, aye, Captain Grandpa.
Peppa Pig.
Peppa Pig.
Peppa Pig.
